description: This file is a PHP template that generates an HTML section displaying a map with impact data and an embedded iframe. It sources configuration and data from class properties and methods, constructing a URL with parameters for rendering the map and impact statistics.
external_files: The file references external configuration and methods, but there are no direct includes or requires visible in the snippet besides the assumption of class usage.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a channel object providing configuration, sections, summary data, and translation functionalities.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Retrieves sections associated with the channel, filtered by type 'map'.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration settings, including map-specific options.

methods.name: getSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of impact data such as amount, projects, and investors.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL for the resource.
